Agent Name: IMDB_Ratings_Expert
Step Number: 8
Reason for Mistake: This step prematurely finalized the conclusion and issued termination based on an incomplete candidate set, misusing upstream data that omitted Nosferatu. By asserting all criteria were met and stopping, it created the first irrecoverable point, preventing correction of the earlier omission and directly locking in the wrong result.

{
  upstream_output:

    data_type: "text"
    producer_steps: [0]
    producer_agents: ["Filmography_Expert"]
  downstream_usage:
  - data_item: "Apply constraints to compile list and filter by runtime."
    consumer_steps: [1]

- type: data_issue

  severity: 0.40

  likely_effect_on_to: S2 compiles an incomplete candidate list, cascading errors into availability checks and ratings.
